comparisonDecision.mechanismContract: Use native Git three-way semantics to integrate the exact reviewed head onto the actual sole merge parent, then require the actual merge tree identity to equal the expected tree identity.
comparisonDecision.whyNotReviewedTouchedPathsOnly: Touched-path comparison can miss unexplained merge-only changes elsewhere and does not prove that all parent-side content survived.
identityAssumptions: GitHub's PR head is exactly the Lane A reviewed head and any required owner-ruling head.
The reported merge and reviewed-head objects exist locally.
The reported merge has exactly one parent, used as the integration target.
Git establishes the required ancestry/base and computes one conflict-free expected tree.
The closure checkout and exact-main proof remain bound to the reported merge.
failClosed: actual tree differs from expected integration tree

acceptance: Clean-head and legitimate nonconflicting intervening-main integrations pass.
Conflicts, missing/invalid identity, and unexplained merge content fail nonzero without completion.
Exact-head review, owner-ruling, CI, runtime, checkout, ancestry and validator gates remain enforced.
The actual PAI identities reproduce through the closure CLI on an isolated ledger fixture before official closure.
Both roadmap-loop Jest files run red-first and green in separate deterministic processes.
